text:
maria: Heads-up — the docs site build is failing on linkcheck for the notebook examples page. CI shows a 404 for a fragment link. dev-bot: CI failure: docs/linkcheck (docusaurus) — https://ci.redwood/1234/status Exit code 1 Error: 404 on /docs/notebooks#notebook-snippets sam: I bumped into this during the mkdocs -> docusaurus migration. The H2 header was renamed and we didn't keep the old slug. Link from /guides/data-science still points to #notebook-snippets. nina: quick fix: add an explicit id to the header in the notebook page so old links still work. Example: ```html

Notebook snippets

``` or in MDX you can do: `## Notebook snippets {#notebook-snippets}` maria: Good. Can we keep the visible header text unchanged? We should avoid changing users' anchors if possible. sam: Yep. I'll open a small PR to reintroduce the anchor and add a test in the linkcheck config. liam: tagging for release notes: if this affects a post-migration redirect we should document it in the migration guide. @maria can you add a line in the migration doc about anchor renames? maria: Will do. Thinking of a short snippet in the migration guide that says "If you renamed headings, add explicit anchors to preserve links" with the MDX and HTML examples. nina: Also: the linkcheck job is strict and treats anchors as 404 even if page exists. Could we add a temporary exception for known-old-anchors in CI while we roll the fix? sam: I'd rather land the page fix quickly. But adding a short list of ignored fragments in linkcheck config for the next deploy is ok to avoid noisy failures. dev-bot: Created issue #482: docs: re-add legacy anchors for notebook examples -> https://tracker.redwood/482 maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — adds `{#notebook-snippets}` to notebooks.md and updates migration guide. Running local linkcheck. sam: Nice. Running `yarn docs:linkcheck` now locally. If green I'll queue for canary. sam: Local linkcheck passed. CI re-run queued. dev-bot: CI passed for linkcheck on branch 789 — build 5552 ✅ liam: Thanks — let's include a one-liner in the next release notes and close the tracker after release. maria: Added release note stub in PR description. cc @nina for wording. nina: LGTM, small wording tweak suggested in the PR. maria: Merged and backported to the migration-guide branch. Closing this thread. :tada:
